name: PDF Editor
description: Read and edit PDF files on your phone: change the text right on the page, highlight and draw, sign, black out private details, and rearrange pages. Opens files straight from other apps, keeps a draft of your edits, and works offline.

workflowSuggestions.title: Sửa file PDF
workflowSuggestions.prompt: Mở PDF Editor và giúp tôi mở một file PDF.
